architecture: Same native two-channel base16 GroupNorm U-Net; no architecture change in first ablation
preserve: existing classifier gate and detector snapshots

data.model_selection: 3 grouped folds within original train124 only; pool held-out-per-fold predictions before metrics
data.original_held32: Already inspected development confirmation only; not a fresh test
data.previous_reserved156: No further selection or threshold exploration
data.future_independent_evaluation: Requires separate pixel-labelled groups with patient identity and pretraining overlap audited
data.fold_role_handling: Only each fold training IDs enter sampler/normalization/mining; explicitly relabel fold-validation rows as validation

fixed_training.initialization: Fresh same random initialization within each paired fold; do not initialize from held-selected v1 checkpoint
fixed_training.negative_centers: Same frozen SAM training-image centers across four controls; entire patch GT-empty rejection
fixed_training.augmentation: Same native horizontal/vertical reflections; no target dilation or small-component deletion

candidate_inference.gate: Fixed as in v1; rejected positives remain in metric denominator
candidate_inference.two_region_rule: Positive if inside box and p>=t_in, or outside box and p>=t_out; t_out>=t_in. Full native image-only inference.
candidate_inference.SAM_intersection: Not a mandatory restriction; frozen SAM remains a comparison/reference

selection.scope: Pool out-of-fold cases from train124; common variant/epoch/policy/threshold across both arms
hard_development_regression_constraints: Per-arm pooled GT TP >= same-image SAM TP
Per-arm positive-image count with any GT overlap >= SAM count
Per-arm negative FP pixel sum <= SAM sum
Per-arm negative image count with any FP <= SAM count
selection.reference_limitation: These are development non-regression references, not clinical sensitivity targets
selection.ranking: Among feasible candidates: greatest mean positive macro Dice across arms, then smallest mean negative FP pixels/image, then deterministic candidate ID
selection.no_feasible_candidate: Return None and report which constraints failed; do not silently relax limits or promote a model

metrics: negative FP pixel sum and per-image count
positive images with any GT overlap
GT eight-connected component coverage at any overlap and >=50% overlap, by area1-4/5-16/17-64/>64pixels; diagnostic geometry, not clinical lesion sensitivity

confirmation.paired_repeats: After promising seed42 result, repeat winner and control with seeds43/44; use one fixed group split and frozen protocol
confirmation.final_fit: After OOF selection, fit original train124 for locked epoch count; evaluate original held32 as development confirmation only

later_isolated_ablation: Larger native context or separate context encoder with original-resolution output; compare at matched pixel budget
Ablate brightness/noise augmentation only after geometry and label preservation checks
Classifier gate misses are a separate routing study: current fixed gate loses one held positive and this study does not change it
